description: Header file defining the DrmPlugin class for ClearKey DRM implementation, including method declarations for DRM operations, session management, and security features.

classes.name: DrmPlugin
classes.description: Implementation of the BnDrmPlugin interface for ClearKey DRM, managing sessions, security, and cryptographic operations.

methods.name: closeSession
methods.description: Closes a DRM session identified by session ID.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts input data using the specified session and key.

methods.name: encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts input data using the specified session and key.

methods.name: getHdcpLevels
methods.description: Retrieves HDCP levels supported.

methods.name: getKeyRequest
methods.description: Generates a key request based on scope, init data, MIME type, and key type.

methods.name: getLogMessages
methods.description: Retrieves DRM log messages.

methods.name: getMetrics
methods.description: Retrieves DRM metrics.

methods.name: getNumberOfSessions
methods.description: Returns the number of active DRM sessions.

methods.name: getOfflineLicenseKeySetIds
methods.description: Gets IDs of offline license key sets.

methods.name: getOfflineLicenseState
methods.description: Retrieves the state of an offline license.

methods.name: getPropertyByteArray
methods.description: Gets a property as a byte array.

methods.name: getPropertyString
methods.description: Gets a property as a string.

methods.name: getProvisionRequest
methods.description: Generates a provisioning request.

methods.name: getSecureStop
methods.description: Retrieves a secure stop object.

methods.name: getSecureStopIds
methods.description: Retrieves secure stop IDs.

methods.name: getSecureStops
methods.description: Retrieves secure stops.

methods.name: getSecurityLevel
methods.description: Gets the security level for a session.

methods.name: openSession
methods.description: Opens a new DRM session with specified security level.

methods.name: provideKeyResponse
methods.description: Provides a response to a key request.

methods.name: provideProvisionResponse
methods.description: Provides a response to a provisioning request.

methods.name: queryKeyStatus
methods.description: Queries the status of keys in a session.

methods.name: releaseAllSecureStops
methods.description: Releases all secure stops.

methods.name: releaseSecureStop
methods.description: Releases a specific secure stop.

methods.name: releaseSecureStops
methods.description: Releases secure stops with provided opaque data.

methods.name: removeAllSecureStops
methods.description: Removes all secure stops.

methods.name: removeKeys
methods.description: Removes keys associated with a session.

methods.name: removeOfflineLicense
methods.description: Removes an offline license.

methods.name: removeSecureStop
methods.description: Removes a specific secure stop.

methods.name: requiresSecureDecoder
methods.description: Checks if a secure decoder is required for a MIME type and security level.

methods.name: restoreKeys
methods.description: Restores keys to a session.

methods.name: setCipherAlgorithm
methods.description: Sets the cipher algorithm for a session.

methods.name: setListener
methods.description: Sets the DRM plugin listener.

methods.name: setMacAlgorithm
methods.description: Sets the MAC algorithm for a session.

methods.name: setPlaybackId
methods.description: Associates a playback ID with a session.

methods.name: setPropertyByteArray
methods.description: Sets a property as a byte array.

methods.name: setPropertyString
methods.description: Sets a property as a string.

methods.name: sign
methods.description: Signs data with a session key.

methods.name: signRSA
methods.description: Signs data using RSA with a session.

methods.name: verify
methods.description: Verifies a signature with a session key.
